display.label: VPN Gateway
display.description: Azure Virtual WAN VPN Gateway for scalable site-to-site VPN connections into an Azure Virtual Hub

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure VPN Gateway. Serves as the map key.

fields.label: VPN Gateway Name
fields.description: Name of the Azure VPN Gateway. Must be 1-80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, underscores, hyphens, or periods.

validation.pattern_error: VPN Gateway name must be 1-80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, underscores, hyphens, or periods.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the VPN Gateway.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the VPN Gateway should be created.

fields.label: Virtual Hub ID
fields.description: The resource ID of the Azure Virtual WAN Virtual Hub in which the VPN Gateway should be created.

fields.label: Scale Unit
fields.description: The Scale Unit for this VPN Gateway (between 1 and 100). Each scale unit provides roughly 500 Mbps aggregate throughput.

sections.label: BGP Routing Settings
sections.description: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) routing configuration for the VPN Gateway.

fields.label: BGP Configuration
fields.description: BGP settings block for dynamic routing.

fields.label: Autonomous System Number (ASN)
fields.description: The Autonomous System Number of the BGP Speaker (e.g. 65515).

fields.label: Peer Weight
fields.description: The weight added to routes learned from this BGP Speaker.

fields.label: Instance 0 Custom BGP IPs
fields.description: List of custom BGP peering APIPA IP addresses (169.254.21.0/24 - 169.254.22.255) for Gateway Instance 0.

fields.label: Instance 1 Custom BGP IPs
fields.description: List of custom BGP peering APIPA IP addresses (169.254.21.0/24 - 169.254.22.255) for Gateway Instance 1.

sections.label: Tagging
sections.description: Resource tags for governance and billing.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to assign to the VPN Gateway.
